name: Ravi
explanation: A stranger who wanders city to city, gathering stories.
content: Ravi belongs nowhere; instead of belonging, he has chosen to tell. Every story brings him a little closer to home.

stories.title: The Silent Song of the North
stories.explanation: Ravi follows a song he has never heard to a city whose name he does not know.

stories.title: Forgotten Letters
stories.explanation: A chest full of letters becomes an invisible thread binding two strangers together.
